meaning: A person who posts rude or upsetting things online on purpose, just to get a reaction and start an argument.
clues: A person who posts just to make other people upset.
They say rude or silly things in comments, then enjoy the angry replies.
The same word names a creature from old Scandinavian stories that lives in caves or hills.
The best answer is usually no answer, because attention is what they want.
It has five letters and starts with T.
assumes: A lurker reads a group but rarely posts
A moderator keeps an online group tidy
A bot is a program that runs on its own

decoys.meaning: Someone who reads an online group but almost never posts or replies.
A person who watches over an online group and removes posts that break the rules.
A program that runs on its own to do simple jobs, such as answering questions in a chat.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a rude person at the club got a stern look. Online, nobody can give a stern look!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: don't reply. Use the Block or Mute button, and you will not see their posts again.

blank.sentence: A person kept posting rude comments on purpose just to start an argument. People call that person a ___.

why: They post rude or upsetting things just to get a reaction.
short: Poster who tries to upset people
